name: Breadcrumbs
description: Show where the current page sits in a site's hierarchy.

name: Button
description: Trigger an action such as saving changes or opening a dialog.

name: Checkbox
description: Select any number of independent options.

name: Data table
description: Compare values across rows and columns.

name: Dialog
description: Focus attention on a decision or a short task.

name: Disclosure
description: Reveal details on demand while keeping the main view concise.

name: Filter chip
description: Show an active filter and offer a way to remove it.

name: Form field
description: Associate an input with its label, instructions, and errors.

name: Listbox
description: Choose one or more entries from a list.

name: Menu
description: Group commands for the current view or selection.

name: Pagination
description: Move through a set of results a page at a time.

name: Progress bar
description: Indicate how far a task has progressed.

name: Radio group
description: Choose one option from a set of alternatives.

name: Search box
description: Enter terms to find content in a site or list.

name: Slider
description: Select a value within a continuous range.

name: Switch
description: Turn a setting on or off.

name: Tabs
description: Switch between related views in the same space.

name: Tooltip
description: Offer a brief explanation for a focused or hovered control.
